description: romMapService parses the rgblink .map build artifact into a structured bank/free-space model
steps: Build the project at least once so a rgblink .map file exists (e.g. pokeprism_nodebug.map)
Point romMapService at the .map file (discovered automatically or read from settings)
Invoke the parse and inspect the resulting model
Verify the model has a per-bank list of ROMX banks, each with bank number, the sections it contains (name, start, end, size), the EMPTY ranges, and the TOTAL EMPTY (free) bytes
Verify the model exposes the ROMX header totals (bytes used, bytes free, number of banks)
Spot-check a known bank against the raw .map text (e.g. ROMX bank #1 sections and TOTAL EMPTY match)

description: ROM-banking features are unavailable until a successful build has produced a .map
steps: Open a freshly cloned project that has never been built
Confirm that no rgblink .map file exists in the workspace
Open the ROM View
Verify the ROM View shows a 'build required' empty state (no bank data) rather than erroring
Verify the empty state offers an action to start a build
Run a build, then reopen the ROM View and verify it now renders the bank model

description: An IPC channel returns the bank/free-space DTO for the renderer; the DTO is fully serializable
steps: Register the ROM IPC channel (registerRomIpc.ts) and confirm it is wired in registerIpc.ts
Invoke the get-rom-map channel from the renderer side
Verify the returned DTO contains the banks array and ROMX totals, or a 'build required' status when no .map exists
Verify the DTO contains no class instances or non-serializable values and is typed in src/shared/types/

description: The ROM View lists banks with their used/free bytes, fill indicator, and contained sections
steps: Open a built project and open the ROM View
Verify each ROMX bank row shows the bank number and bytes used / free with a fill indicator
Expand a bank and verify its sections are listed with names and sizes, plus the free/EMPTY space
Verify the header shows the ROMX totals (used / free / bank count)
Verify the figures match the parsed .map model for at least one spot-checked bank

description: Adding a new map presents the ROM View as a manual bank picker; v1 does not auto-pick a bank
steps: Open a built project and start the 'add a new map' flow
Verify the user is prompted to choose a target bank, with per-bank free space shown to inform the choice
Verify no bank is pre-selected automatically (v1 placement is manual)
Choose a bank with sufficient free space and confirm the map creation
Verify the chosen bank id is carried with the create-map command to the main process as placement data

description: The patcher emits a new map's section into the user-chosen bank using the pokecrystal profile mechanic (pinned BANK)
steps: Use a pokecrystal-profile project and add a new map, choosing a specific target bank
Trigger a patch
Verify the patched ASM declares the new map's section pinned to the chosen bank (e.g. SECTION "...", ROMX, BANK[$xx])
Verify the new maps/Name.asm file is created (after the confirmation dialog)
Build and verify rgblink places the section in the chosen bank

description: The patcher emits a new map's section into the user-chosen bank using the prism profile mechanic (linkerscript edit)
steps: Use a prism-profile project and add a new map, choosing a specific target bank $xx
Trigger a patch
Verify the patched ASM declares the new map's SECTION
Verify the section name is inserted under the chosen ROMX $xx block in the linkerscript contents/romx.link
Verify the edited romx.link is one of the buffers written atomically with the rest of the patch
Build and verify the section lands in bank $xx

description: romMapService only reads the .map; it never runs builds or writes banking changes
steps: Inspect romMapService and confirm it performs no build invocation (builds are makeService's responsibility)
Confirm it performs no writes to ASM files or the linkerscript (banking writes are the patcher's responsibility)
Confirm the service degrades gracefully (returns a 'build required' status) when the .map is missing or unparseable rather than throwing
